pages.text: $(item)Harmonic of Chronos$()$(br2)A frequency that does not belong to any single moment. It bends time around whatever it touches.
$(bold)Attunement$()$(br)Strike an Unattuned Fork against an Enchanting Table exactly at midnight. This will tune it to become the Harmonic of Chronos.

$(bold)Use$()$(br)Hold (shift) right-click while aiming at a block, and release once you have charged long enough. The longer you charge, the greater the acceleration placed on that block, doubling with every second held.$(br2)Charging draws on your hunger, so accelerating time comes at a cost. Some blocks may resist the effect entirely and cannot be accelerated.
